findings.label: Incident counts ignore DB community reports
findings.detail: reportCounts(state.reports) only counts the in-memory BDRRMC log; resident reports filed via /api/reports never change the Operations Grid / Reports tab pending/resolved figures. Fold ReportsTab data into the counts or label the card as the walk-in/hotline log only.

findings.label: M10 hazard map missing
findings.detail: Matrix lists 'Hazard maps: their barangay' for the Barangay Official; BarangayAnalyticsPanel renders no map (the plan's OSM embed was dropped). Add the osmEmbedUrl iframe or a static flood-map row with attribution.

findings.label: M5 livestock-owner alert missing
findings.detail: Matrix grants 'Livestock protection advisory: Alert livestock owners'; AgricultureAreaPanel / AGRI_ROWS has no livestock row or broadcast action. Add one row plus an SMS-demo action.

findings.label: Emergency strip text is hazard-agnostic
findings.detail: brgy.emergencyStrip always says 'SEVERE TROPICAL STORM PROTOCOL' even for flood/landslide alerts. Interpolate the alert type or typhoon name.

findings.label: Broadcast has no visible log
findings.detail: SafetyCommunityPanel sends via smsProvider but does not render <SmsBroadcastLog /> as planned; only a status line and an audit entry confirm the send.
